mapper.select: /*selectSellerMpIvExcelUploadPopList*/ SELECT T.SEQ, T.EXCEL_TYPE, T.ATTR_1 AS COM_CODE, T.ATTR_2 AS BUYER_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE STATUS <> 'D' AND COM_CODE = F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(T.ATTR_2, '01')) AS BUYER_NAME, P.DESCRIPTION, P.SPECIFICATION, T.ATTR_3 AS INV_NO, T.ATTR_4 AS PARCEL_COM_CODE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'C019' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE = T.ATTR_4) AS PARCEL_COM_NAME, T.ATTR_5 AS PARCEL_INV_NO, T.ADD_DATE, T.ADD_USER_ID, T.CHANGE_DATE, T.CHANGE_USER_ID FROM KEP_EXCEL_TMP T , ICOMIVHD H , ICOMIVDT D , ICOMPODT P WHERE 1=1 AND T.ATTR_1 = H.AGENT AND T.ATTR_2 = H.BUYER AND T.ATTR_3 = H.INV_NO AND H.BUYER = D.BUYER AND H.INV_NO = D.INV_NO AND D.BUYER = P.BUYER AND D.PO_NO = P.PO_NO AND D.PO_SEQ = P.PO_SEQ AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND T.EXCEL_TYPE = #{st_excel_type} AND T.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ORDER BY SEQ

/*getSellerMpIvExcelUploadPop_v2*/ SELECT T.SEQ, T.EXCEL_TYPE, T.ATTR_1 AS COM_CODE, T.ATTR_2 AS BUYER_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE STATUS <> 'D' AND COM_CODE = F_GET_HIDDEN_BUYER_NAME(T.ATTR_2, '01')) AS BUYER_NAME, T.ATTR_3 AS INV_NO, T.ATTR_4 AS PARCEL_COM_CODE, T.ATTR_5 AS PARCEL_INV_NO, T.ADD_DATE, T.ADD_USER_ID, T.CHANGE_DATE, T.CHANGE_USER_ID FROM KEP_EXCEL_TMP T , ICOMIVHD H WHERE 1=1 AND T.ATTR_1 = H.AGENT AND T.ATTR_2 = H.BUYER AND T.ATTR_3 = H.INV_NO AND H.STATUS <> 'D' AND T.EXCEL_TYPE = #{st_excel_type} AND T.ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ORDER BY SEQ
mapper.update: /*insertMpIvAddTemp*/ INSERT INTO KEP_EXCEL_TMP ( SEQ, EXCEL_TYPE, ATTR_1, ATTR_2, ATTR_3, ATTR_4, ATTR_5, ADD_DATE, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_USER_ID ) SELECT DECODE(MAX(SEQ), NULL, 1, MAX(SEQ)+1), #{st_excel_type}, #{st_com_code}, #{BUYER_CODE}, #{INV_NO}, #{PARCEL_COM_CODE}, #{PARCEL_INV_NO}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id}, SYSDATE, #{st_user_id} FROM KEP_EXCEL_TMP
